land_pattern.package: 2-pole THT vertical screw terminal, 5.08 mm pitch
land_pattern.notes: Same family drawing as C474953.json: 'PCB Hole Diameter [mm]: 1.4', pitch 5.08 mm, pin cross-section ~0.80x0.90 mm (diagonal ~1.20 mm), 'Pin Dimensions [mm]: 4.3'. CORRECTED 2026-08-16 (coordinator ruling, P3 librarian pass): the PULLED (easyeda2kicad) 2-pole footprint originally measured a 1.600 mm drill on the 2.4 mm pad - 0.2 mm OVER this datasheet's 1.4 mm figure - while the mechanically identical pin on the sibling 3-pole catalog entry (C474953, J1) pulled at an exact 1.4 mm match. Neither value was an undersized-drill hazard (annulus 0.40 mm at 1.6 mm vs 0.50 mm at 1.4 mm, both far above the 0.15 mm JLC/fp_verify floor), but the mismatch was accepted as a genuine catalog inconsistency with no upside: one family, two drill sizes, on a board where all three screw terminals are hand-soldered and take real mechanical load from wire-insertion/screw torque, so the tighter datasheet-nominal fit (lead + 0.20 mm, a normal hand/wave-solder window) is the right way to err versus the looser lead + 0.40 mm. `boards/bb-amp/lib/aiee.pretty/CONN-TH_P5.08_KF128-5.08-2P.kicad_mod` was hand-edited to drill 1.399998 mm on both pads (was 1.599996 mm) to match this datasheet exactly and match J1's footprint, dropping the board to one drill size across all three connectors. Re-verified clean after the edit: fp_verify 0 violations, kicad-cli load check ok, scratch-board DRC 0 violations (boards/bb-amp/log/fp_verify-J2J3-P3.json, fpfix-verify-J2J3-P3.json).
